content_sections.heading: About District Child Protection Unit Tiruvannamalai
content_sections.text: The District Child Protection Unit, Tiruvannamalai is headed by the District Collector as Chairperson and is located at Taluk Office Campus, Periyar Silai, Near Sub Jail, Tiruvannamalai. The Support Persons positions are meant to provide necessary support and guidance to child victims of sexual offences during investigation and court proceedings under the POCSO Act, 2012.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice invites two kinds of applicants, and either may apply: Persons or organizations working for child rights or child protection. Persons with a post-graduate degree in Social Work, Sociology, Law, Psychology, Child Development, Health, or Education. Graduates with 3 years of experience in child protection/development fields. Persons with child rights violations and other criminal cases are not eligible to apply. The notice names no desirable qualification. Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility detail.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The positions are filled completely on a temporary basis, and the payment is an honorarium for each case, not a fixed monthly salary.

rows.honorarium: Rs. 10,000/- per case, released in 4 installments of Rs. 2,500/- each

faq.question: Q1. How many Support Persons posts are there?
faq.answer: The District Child Protection Unit, Tiruvannamalai has announced 20 Support Persons positions.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the office by 5:45 PM on 04.12.2026. Applications are accepted from 20.11.2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Support Persons?
faq.answer: Persons or organizations working for child rights or child protection, persons with a post-graduate degree in Social Work, Sociology, Law, Psychology, Child Development, Health or Education, or graduates with 3 years of experience in child protection/development fields can apply.

faq.question: Q4. How much is the honorarium?
faq.answer: The honorarium is Rs. 10,000/- per case, released in 4 installments of Rs. 2,500/- each.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply?
faq.answer: Submit the Google Form and send photocopies of the relevant certificates by post or courier to the District Child Protection Officer, Tiruvannamalai. The application can be downloaded from http://tiruvannamalai.nic.in.

faq.question: Q6. Is the Support Person job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The notice says the positions are filled completely on a temporary basis, based on honorarium.

faq.question: Q7. Who is not eligible to apply?
faq.answer: Persons with child rights violations and other criminal cases are not eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q8. What happens to incomplete applications?
faq.answer: Incomplete applications and those without the necessary supporting certificates will be summarily rejected without prior notice, and no correspondence will be entertained.
